prototype.source_description: Independent dedicated DFS prototype with prefix and two-multiple-prime symmetry reductions; excludes checkpoint/b-file writes

notes: Existing checkpoint and b-file were not used as bounds for the fresh prototype run.
Legacy timings are saved user-run statistics, not a controlled A/B benchmark.
The integrated executable has been checked on short ranges; the 61-term prototype timing is not a guarantee for the integrated writer or other machines.
The integrated program has not been run to 61 against the user checkpoint.
